files.name: README.md

files.name: 717_LSG_candidates.csv
files.description: One row per lineage-specific gene candidate (1,611): phylostratum, each exclusion criterion, reason, final-set flag (Table 3.S1 as a flat file).

files.name: 717_gene_pairs.csv
files.description: One row per gene pair (47,923): sWGD and aWGT anchor pairs, tandem pairs with Ks and Ka/Ks, pairings inside multi-copy syntelog groups.

files.name: 717_genes.csv
files.description: One row per gene (63,960): duplication classes, tandem array, syntelog category, strict PAV, tau and expression summaries, annotation.

files.name: 717_tandem_arrays.csv
files.description: One row per tandem array (4,204): size, median Ks, age bin, status compared with the other haplotype.

files.description: Table 2.S2. Pairs excluded because their reads cannot be assigned to one copy, with the effect on each pair metric.

files.name: Table_2.S3_tandem_chromosome_enrichment.csv
files.description: Table 2.S3. Tandem genes per chromosome compared with expectation, array-intact permutation test.

files.description: Table 2.S4. The 553 gene models flagged by quality control, with the reason.
